title: Libra Zodiac Sign: Personality, Love, Career & Compatibility
intro: Libra (September 23 – October 22) is the charming air sign ruled by Venus. Fair, social and stylish, Libra seeks harmony, beauty and balance in everything.
personality: Libra is the diplomat of the zodiac. They see every side of a story, love fairness and hate conflict. Charming and sociable, they make people feel welcome and understood. They have an eye for design and beauty, but their wish to please everyone can make decisions difficult.
love: Libra is a true romantic who loves partnership. They want a relationship built on equality, kindness and shared beauty. Honest conversations and little romantic gestures keep them happy.
career: Libra thrives in law, design, fashion, diplomacy, HR, public relations and any role that needs balance, taste and people skills.
friendship: Libra is the friend who keeps the group together, mediates arguments and always knows the nicest place to go.

faq.q: What is the Libra personality like?
faq.ans: Libra is fair, charming, social and loves harmony and beauty.

faq.q: Who is Libra most compatible with?
faq.ans: Libra usually matches well with Gemini, Aquarius and Leo.
Libra is ruled by Venus, the planet of love and beauty.
